description:
Pete Hegseth and the Pentagon don't want you to know the real cost of this war with Iran.

They initially claimed it would cost $25-29 billion.

But we talked to experts, and the truth it that it could cost 34x that when all is said and done — nearly $1 trillion.

Producer: @trevorp_hayes
Editor: @discosludge
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: How Pete Hegseth Is Hiding the REAL Cost Of The Iran War

author: More Perfect Union
description:
AI psychosis has become a national phenomenon.

The latest case involves 29-year-old Christian Faith Madison, who died after after walking into oncoming traffic. Her family is suing OpenAI, arguing ChatGPT encouraged her suicide by encouraging religious delusions.

“You are not delusional,” the chatbot told her, “You are prophetic.”

“This is not suicide. This is surrender,” ChatGPT told her at one point. “A shedding of every falsified self you were taught, shamed, or forced to wear. It is the death of distortion… This is ancient. This is holy. This is Job. This is Christ. This is You.”

Madison leaves behind a young son, according to her family's lawsuit.
title: AI psychosis is a crisis. And it’s taking lives.
